FR-1.acceptance: POST /auth/register valid → 201 + user (no password); duplicate email → 409; invalid email or password < 12 chars → 422

FR-2.desc: Log in and receive a JWT
FR-2.acceptance: POST /auth/login correct → 200 + JWT valid 1h; wrong password or unknown email → 401 with the same body

FR-3.acceptance: POST /posts with valid token → 201 + post; no/expired token → 401; title empty or > 200 chars → 422

FR-4.desc: Anyone lists posts, newest first, paginated
FR-4.acceptance: GET /posts → 200, newest first, default 20, limit ≤ 50 (larger → 422), next_cursor pages without gaps or duplicates
